fusions.name: Planted Shove
fusions.desc: Drives the butt of the haft into the target, dealing 13 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Crag Reach
fusions.desc: Reaches up to 7 tiles to a target and deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Unmoved
fusions.desc: Sets the haft and your feet: for 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.
